system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Your bloodline can only take you so far in this world. You begin to learn how to utilize your brutish physicality in ways unique to your clan known as Predator Surges. Predator Surges are special techniques that you can utilize as part of combat to infuse your onslaught with Hoshigaki power. Unlike other clans that learn and can never adapt, your clan utilizes an instinctual form of combat similar to a Shark, allowing you to learn the useful techniques and forget the ones that aren’t useful. When you complete a long rest, select two Predator Surges from the following list. You can use one surge as part of any trigger. If a Surge requires a saving throw, use your highest jutsu saving throw to determine the surges DC.

Predators Terrain

Trigger: As part of casting a Jutsu

When you cast a Jutsu with the Water release keyword that affects an area, you can use this surge to cause the affected area to become difficult terrain for the next minute for all creatures, excluding yourself and up to 3 creatures of your choice.

Creatures that attempt to move through this area can spend 10 chakra to ignore this difficult terrain effect until the end of their turn.

Predators Drag

Trigger: As part of making a melee attack

When you score a hit with a melee attack, you can use this surge to suddenly bite down, or grab an enemy in such a way that you have them held down. The affected creature becomes Grappled and you immediately can move up to twice your full speed pulling them along with you. While grappled in this way the affected creature cannot take reactions. Once you’ve finished this movement, you end the grapple on the affected creature.

Predators Clarity

Trigger: As part of taking damage

When you take damage from a creature, you can use this surge to mark the triggering creature until the end of your next turn. When you do, you become aware of them if they are invisible or are hidden from you.

Predators Rend

Trigger: As part of making a melee attack

When you deal damage as a result of a melee attack, you deliver it via your sharpened teeth, which allows you to rend your opponent’s defenses, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you reduce their DR by 2 for the next minute. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

Predators Crash

Trigger: As part of casting a Jutsu

When you cast a jutsu with the Water release keyword that affects a creature protected by a Barrier, you can use this Surge to destabilize the barrier, causing half of the damage you deal to also affect creatures protected by the barrier.

Predators Feeding

Trigger: As part of taking damage

When you take damage from a creature as a result of a melee attack you can use this Surge to spend your reaction, to take the Attack action, targeting the triggering creature with attacks made as a result.
